sloka: दिशः पर्याकुलाः च आसन् तमसा तेन दूषिताः ।चचाल च मही सर्वा स शैल वन कानना ॥४-३९-९॥
transliteration: diśaḥ paryākulāḥ ca āsan tamasā tena dūṣitāḥ ।cacāla ca mahī sarvā sa śaila vana kānanā ॥4-39-9॥

translations.english: By the spreading of dust, the quarters were not visible.The earth including the mountains gardens and forests was shaken up.
